findings.issue: Filename sanitization handles path separators (/ and \), dangerous chars, and .. sequences. The double-layer approach (Path.name + regex replace) is correct. Passes all unit tests.
Service account key path is read from env var at call time (not at import). This is correct — env var is validated at startup by app.py validate_config().
No file size limit check before downloading. A very large file could exhaust disk space. For a local school tool with known file sizes this is low risk, but worth noting.
findings.suggestion: Optionally check 'size' field from Drive metadata before downloading and skip files above a threshold (e.g. 50MB).
